defects.description: Detector flagged reclining (globalTilt missing) but description explicitly says Sit on the floor — seated forward-fold stretch, NOT reclining.
Description says both legs extended straight ahead with a SOFT BEND in the knees. Baseline has both knees at 100° flexion (deep right-angle bend), NOT extended. Should be ~10-20° (soft bend).

Description says reach both hands forward toward toes or rest on shins. Baseline arms are near-neutral (slight backward), not reaching forward. Renderer-limited: shoulder-to-toe distance exceeds arm length so hands cannot fully reach toes; partial forward reach is the best achievable.

failing_tests.assertion: both knees should have soft bend (knee flexion between 5° and 25°)
both arms should reach forward (sagittal flexion > 10°)

regression_risk: low — knee change is the critical fix; arm forward reach is minor improvement; verified no anomalies/plausibility flags
rationale: Reclining flag is FALSE POSITIVE — description says Sit on the floor with both legs extended (seated forward stretch, not lying down). Primary defect: knee flexion 100° (deep right-angle bend) contradicts soft bend in the knees for extended legs. leftKnee/rightKnee 100→15 (soft bend per tip — locked-straight reads stiffer). Empirical verify: feet_min_y drops from 0.5 to 0.1 (feet near floor, correct for extended legs on floor). Secondary defect: arms not reaching forward. Per actual renderer convention (empirically verified), NEGATIVE shoulderFwdL/R moves wrist FORWARD when shoulder in default abduction (renderer comment inverted). shoulderFwdL/R:-25 produces sagittal flexion +12°/+17° (forward), wrists at z=+0.07/+0.17 (forward of body, partial reach toward toes). Full toe-reach is renderer-limited (shoulder-to-toe distance 0.91 exceeds arm length 0.75).
